77195.subject: The new MOL Bubi has arrived – you can now see the public bikes in BudapestGO
77195.body:
![BudapestGO] (https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=75345802&N=304&L=25&F=T)

Dear Oleg Novosadov,
The new MOL Bubi is here: starting 3 August, the revamped public
bike-sharing system will be available to everyone, featuring brand-new
classic and electric-assist bicycles!

Your BudapestGO pass is now worth even more!
If you have a valid monthly or longer-term public transport pass for
Budapest in the BudapestGO app, you can purchase a classic MOL Bubi Monthly
or Annual Pass at a discounted rate. In BudapestGO, you can now also find
MOL Bubi stations and see available bikes, making it easy to plan your
journey.
![Freedom on two wheels]
(https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=75345802&N=304&L=148&F=T)
What do you need to do if you want to ride a Bubi?

1. Download the new MOL Bubi app
•

For iPhone, click [here]
(https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=75345802&N=304&L=149&F=T) .
•

For Android smartphones, click [here]
(https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=75345802&N=304&L=150&F=T) .

2. Register in the app
•

To register, you’ll need a phone number where we can send the
verification code.
Important: If you’d like to take advantage of the discount associated
with your valid BudapestGO pass, please use the same email address in the
MOL Bubi app as you do in BudapestGO.
•

Fill in your details and register your bankcard

3. If you have a valid pass in the BudapestGO app, you are eligible for a
discounted monthly or annual MOL Bubi Pass for classic bikes. (If you
don’t have a pass in BudapestGO, you can choose the MOL Bubi Pass type
that suits you best, or use the service on a pay-as-you-go basis.)

For more information about MOL Bubi's pricing and service details, visit
the MOL Bubi website at [molbubi.hu]
(https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=75345802&N=304&L=151&F=T) .

4. You’re ready to roll!
Open BudapestGO or the MOL Bubi app to find the nearest MOL Bubi station
and see which bikes are available. Then, use the MOL Bubi app to scan the
QR code on the bike's frame, unlock it, and you're ready to ride!
During the pilot phase before the official launch, your favorite new
features were the electric bikes, the easier saddle adjustment, the faster
locking mechanism, and the new app. The pilot not only helped improve the
system but also provided valuable insights for reviewing the service's
pricing. Based on feedback from testers and consultations with experts, the
next generation of MOL Bubi launched with a more [affordable pricing
structure] (https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=75345802&N=304&L=156&F=T) .

Best regards,
BKK Centre for Budapest Transport
This newsletter is sent to your email address registered in BudapestGO on
the basis of the legitimate interest of BKK as data controller. If you no
longer wish to receive messages related to the service, you can unsubscribe
by clicking [here]
(https://hirlevel.bkk.hu/link.php?M=75345802&N=304&L=72&F=T) . You can
